description: This file implements functions related to parsing and converting messages and device details for Zigbee legacy devices, including message parsing, device info conversion, and resource updates in a Zigbee security context.

methods.name: bool parseDeviceInfoMessage(const uint8_t * message,uint16_t messageLen,uCDeviceInfoMessage * deviceInfoMessage)
methods.description: Parses a device info message buffer into a uCDeviceInfoMessage structure, extracting firmware version, device type, status, configuration, and thresholds.

methods.name: char * deviceInfoMessageToString(uCDeviceInfoMessage * message)
methods.description: Converts a uCDeviceInfoMessage structure into a human-readable string representation.

methods.name: bool getLegacyDeviceDetails(uCDeviceType devType,uint32_t firmwareVersion,LegacyDeviceDetails ** details)
methods.description: Determines the legacy device details based on device type and firmware version, allocating and populating a LegacyDeviceDetails structure.

methods.name: LegacyDeviceDetails * cloneLegacyDeviceDetails(const LegacyDeviceDetails * src)
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a LegacyDeviceDetails structure.

methods.name: void legacyDeviceDetailsDestroy__auto(LegacyDeviceDetails ** details)
methods.description: Auto-generated wrapper for destroying a LegacyDeviceDetails object.

methods.name: void legacyDeviceDetailsDestroy(LegacyDeviceDetails * details)
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a LegacyDeviceDetails structure.

methods.name: LegacyDeviceConfig getLegacyDeviceConfig(uCDeviceType devType)
methods.description: Returns a default configuration for a given device type.

methods.name: bool getLegacyDeviceConfigMessage(uCDeviceType devType,uint8_t devNum,uint8_t region,uint8_t ** payload,uint8_t * payloadLen)
methods.description: Builds a device configuration message payload based on device type, device number, and region.

methods.name: bool parseDeviceStatus(uint8_t endpointId,const uint8_t * message,uint16_t messageLen,uCStatusMessage * status)
methods.description: Parses a status message buffer into a uCStatusMessage structure, handling different endpoint message lengths.

methods.name: bool parseKeypadMessage(uint8_t * message,uint16_t messageLen,uCKeypadMessage * keypadMessage)
methods.description: Parses a keypad message buffer, extracting device number, button action, code, battery voltage, RSSI, temperature, and other metrics.

methods.name: bool parseKeyfobMessage(uint8_t * message,uint16_t messageLen,uCKeyfobMessage * keyfobMessage)
methods.description: Parses a keyfob message buffer, extracting device number, button presses, battery voltage, RSSI, and success counts.

methods.name: uint32_t getFirmwareVersionFromDeviceInfoMessage(uCDeviceInfoMessage deviceInfoMessage)
methods.description: Extracts firmware version as a 32-bit integer from a device info message.

methods.name: uint32_t convertLegacyFirmwareVersionToUint32(const uint8_t firmwareVer[3])
methods.description: Converts a 3-byte firmware version array into a 32-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: void legacyDeviceUpdateCommonResources(const DeviceServiceCallbacks * deviceService,const uint64_t eui64,const uCStatusMessage * status,bool isBatteryLow)
methods.description: Updates device resources with status data such as LQI, RSSI, battery, temperature, and low battery alert.

methods.name: uCLegacyDeviceClassification getLegacyDeviceClassification(uCDeviceType devType)
methods.description: Returns a default classification for a device type (currently constant UC_DEVICE_CLASS_UNKNOWN).
